sources: Reserve Florida (floridardr.usedirect.com/FloridaRDR/rdr search/place 42, search/grid and search/details for every unit of facility 112, start date 2026-11-10), read 2026-10-21

values.note: $31 a night for an RV: the $24 campsite fee plus the $7 nightly utility fee for RV units (tent campers pay $24), plus tax and a $6.70 nonrefundable reservation fee. Florida residents 65 and over get half off the base campsite fee.

fees.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-talbot-island-state-park/hours-fees ('$24 per night plus tax, plus a nonrefundable $6.70 reservation fee and a $7 nightly utility fee for RV, cabin, bungalow, boat and yurt units ... (Utility fee does not apply to tent camping.)') + Reserve Florida search/details for facility 112 (every unit Rate 24.00, Fee 6.70), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park page says 20- and 30-amp; Reserve Florida's unit details list 'Electric Hookup 50' on every site. No sewer listed.

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-talbot-island-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Each of the campsites has 20- and 30-amp electricity, fresh water, fire ring and picnic table') + Reserve Florida search/details for facility 112 (Water Hookup on every unit, no Sewer Hookup), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve Florida sells 19 sites: 8 'RV or Tent' (4 of them take 30 ft, the rest 15-20 ft) and 11 'Tent or Pop-Up Only'; the park page says 20. Several RV sites 'can get wet during times of some high tides'.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-talbot-island-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Maximum RV length = 30 feet', 'will have 20 campsites') + Reserve Florida search/grid and search/details for facility 112 (RV or Tent #013/014/016/021 VehicleLength 30; #017-020 15-20; Tent Only #001-011), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-talbot-island-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('two bathhouses with hot showers', 'A dump station is available at the campground exit for RV campers'), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-talbot-island-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Reservations can be made up to 11 months in advance for Florida residents and 10 months in advance for non-residents. For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521') + Reserve Florida search/place 42 Restrictions (MinimumStay 1, MaximumStay 14), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $31 RV night ($24 + $7 utility, $6.70 reservation fee) and Reserve Florida booking (11-month resident window, 14-night max). Added 20/30-amp electric + water (no sewer listed), 19 sites (8 RV, 4 of them 30 ft; 11 tent/pop-up only), 30-ft max, showers and dump station. No storm/Isaias banner on the park pages read. Not stated: season (park hours only), fcfs (inherited). AWH note kept.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is 'coastal woods' but the --AWH note says 'Park is on the ocean but campground is not waterfront', and the park page puts the sites 'an easy half-mile trip from the beach'. The page also says 'Winding tidal creeks border the western edge of the campground' (Myrtle Creek, kayak launch and dock), and Reserve Florida says several RV sites 'can get wet during times of some high tides'.
Only 4 sites take a 23-ft rig (RV or Tent #013, #014, #016, #021 at 30 ft); the other RV sites are 15-20 ft.
Missing phone: the park's number is 904-251-2320 (https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/little-talbot-island-state-park).
